mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary conditions, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day S&P 500 returns are not significantly higher during periods of low FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 8% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate falls below 8% but the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP and housing starts indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both GDP and housing starts increase but the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests supply expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases but the S&P 500 does not show positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in CPI suggests inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If CPI increases by more than 2% but the S&P 500 does not show negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns during periods of low unemployment more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate combined with stable CPI suggests supportive monetary policy without inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both FEDFUNDS are low and CPI is stable but the S&P 500 does not show positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales increase by more than 5% but the S&P 500 does not show positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
